# Northstar Ops — GeoIntelligence & Service Operations Hub

> Parameterized GeoIntelligence platform and Atlassian Forge / Rovo MCP ecosystem for local service operators. Features a verified Radom case study (10–100 km radius, powered by real local pricing from pranie-dywanow.j.pl), dynamic OpenStreetMap + Wikidata discovery for any city worldwide, AI competitor scanning, and native Atlassian Forge Rovo Agent + Skill + MCP Server integration.

## Live Application & Endpoints
- Interactive Web Hub: `https://radom-geo-intelligence.vercel.app`
- Privacy Policy: `https://radom-geo-intelligence.vercel.app/privacy`
- Terms of Service: `https://radom-geo-intelligence.vercel.app/terms`
- Web MCP Discovery (`GET`): `/api/mcp`
- Web MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 Execution (`POST`): `/api/mcp` (`initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`)

## Web App MCP Tools (`/api/mcp`)
- `analyzeCompetitors({ center, radiusKm, industryId?, townsInRadius?, competitorsTracked?, locale? })`
  - Evaluates competitor price positioning, serviceable towns inside `radiusKm` (10–100), and customer review pain points.
- `calculateServiceFee({ town, orderValue })`
  - Computes zone travel surcharge and total customer quote in PLN for supported towns.
- `generateLocalizedCampaign({ season, targetTowns, industryId?, locale? })`
  - Generates localized go-to-market strategy copy tailored to verified customer pain points.
- `exportStrategyToConfluence({ center, radiusKm, season, industryId?, townsInRadius?, competitorsTracked?, benchmarks?, locale? })`
  - Publishes a live formatted Confluence strategy page via Atlassian REST API v2.
- `createJiraMarketingEpics({ center, radiusKm, industryId?, townsInRadius?, competitorsTracked?, locale? })`
  - Creates a Jira marketing Epic with localized town subtasks via Atlassian REST API v3.
- `createCustomerQuote({ center, town, serviceKey, serviceLabel?, quantity?, unitLabel?, unitPricePln, travelFeePln, totalPln, inZone?, locale? })`
  - Creates a live Jira customer quote task directly from the Customer Price Preview calculator.

## Atlassian Forge App (`northstar-ops-rovo/`)
- Manifest location: `northstar-ops-rovo/manifest.yml`
- Forge Runtime: `nodejs24.x` (`Runs on Atlassian` eligible, zero external egress)
- Modules:
  - `rovo:agent` (`northstar-ops-geo-strategist`)
  - `rovo:skill` (`geo-pricing-strategist` in `northstar-ops-rovo/skills/geo-pricing-strategist/SKILL.md`)
  - `rovo:mcp` (`northstar-ops-mcp` Forge MCP Server exposing all 4 Rovo actions)
  - `action` + `function`: `get-market-brief`, `calculate-service-fee`, `publish-confluence-playbook`, `create-jira-campaign`
- Required scopes: `read:space:confluence`, `write:page:confluence`, `read:jira-work`, `write:jira-work`
